# Flood insurance data

> What U.S. homeowners actually pay for NFIP flood insurance, by state, county, ZIP and flood zone, with claims history, flood risk and community discounts, all computed from FEMA's public records (OpenFEMA). Not quotes, not advice, not endorsed by FEMA.

Every "median" below is the median yearly cost (premium plus fees) of existing NFIP policies on single-family primary homes, in force on August 31, 2026. Private flood insurance is not in FEMA's data. How each figure is counted: https://floodinsurancedata.com/methodology/

## Tools
- [Flood zone map lookup by address (FEMA's own map service, not an official determination)](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-zone-map/)
- [Flood insurance cost by ZIP code](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-insurance/zip/)
- [How often NFIP flood claims got paid, by county, since 2020 (+ CSV)](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-insurance/claims/)
- [The NFIP in numbers](https://floodinsurancedata.com/nfip/)
- [What renters pay for NFIP flood insurance](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-insurance/renters/)
- [What flood zone AE means and what it costs](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-zones/ae/)
- [What flood zone X means and what it costs](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-zones/x/)
- [What flood zone VE means and what it costs](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-zones/ve/)
- [What flood zone A means and what it costs](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-zones/a/)
- [What flood zone AO means and what it costs](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-zones/ao/)
- [What flood zone AH means and what it costs](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-zones/ah/)
- [What flood zone D means](https://floodinsurancedata.com/flood-zones/d/)
